shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#5 at its new head `b24c499`. The merge now waits only on `experiment-repo`'s review.

- **Checks:** `hutian/delivery` and `hutian/document` both pass, and `code/README.md` is now in the candidate.
- **Length and order:** the built PDF is 19 pages. The References heading falls on page 9, so the main text is within the 9-page NeurIPS 2026 limit. The checklist follows the references, and the appendix comes after.
- **Template:** `venue/neurips_2026.sty`, `neurips_2026.tex` and `checklist.tex` are byte-identical to the official template.
- **Open note:** one embedded Type 3 font, `F53`, remains. It satisfies "embedded", so it doesn't block the approval.

I read the PDF from the `dev` build, because `pull-5/document.pdf` was still built from the older head `b5b17c0`. `dev` is built from the same commit as the candidate head.
